text:
sam: Nimbus (insurance) asked for a 3-week pilot. Requirements: streaming partial claim parses into their UI, function/tool calls to their extractor, SOC2 procurement answers, and a headline reserved price. Need a compact dev handoff + price blurb.

jenna: Stack? Node frontend (WS or SSE), Python workers, tiny Go ingress?

sam: Yes, thats the stack. Frontend prefers WS but SSE acceptable.

miguel: Quick Node pattern (SSE):
```js
const s = client.stream({model:'redwood-large',stream:true,structured_output:true,tools:[{name:'claim_extract'}]});
s.on('function_call', async (c)=>{ const res = await fetch('/adapter/extract',{method:'POST',body:JSON.stringify({text:c.args.text})}); await s.resume({tool_result:await res.json()}); });
```
Use WS if they need true bidirectional low-latency. SSE works for one-way UI updates with resume.

devon: Ops defaults for a small POC: batch_size=1, max_concurrency=3, token_window=4096, prefix_kv_cache=true. If docs >4k enable KV cache. Use quantized runtime if latency is critical (expect minor quality tradeoff). Set fallback policy to smaller-model to avoid failures under contention.

priya: For SOC2 packet I need: customer security contact, sample (redacted) payload, region/residency requirement, retention window desire, and whether they will send PII/PHI. If PII: recommend Redwood Private (VPC) for the pilot.

elaine: Pricing sketch for a 3-week reserved pilot: small reserved bucket (1-2 qps) ~$5k-$7k depending on model + list-rate overage. Offer a one-time POC discount (15-20%) and a small testing credit; longer log retention is add-on. Will prepare a 1-pager.

sam: Can someone confirm SSE emits function_call and tool_result events so the UI can show partial fields?

miguel: Confirmed. Pattern: model emits function_call -> adapter invoked -> adapter posts tool_result via /streams/resume -> stream emits structured deltas. Works with SSE.

jenna: I'll assemble Postman + minimal Node/Python snippets for handoff. Miguel -> finalize samples. Devon -> ops runbook. Priya -> prefilled security answers template. Elaine -> pricing + SOW blurb. Aim to ship customer package in 24h.

redwood-bot: Please tag #poc-handovers when assets are uploaded so sales-ops can queue onboarding.

sam: Thanks all, will loop Nimbus once bundle is ready.
